evidence: Modifies core configuration and argument handling in src/common/args.cpp, src/common/args.h, and src/init.cpp.
rationale: Fixes multiple bugs and counterintuitive behaviors across startup argument parsing where negated options crashed the node or produced unexpected side effects. As noted in the description, negated options caused crashes ("-nolimitclustercount hits an assertion in TxGraph"), security surprises ("-norpcpassword set the RPC password to '0'"), and inverted behavior ("-notorcontrol made the node connect to the Tor control port").
